issue.title: Take card pericope subtitle truncates on Record tab
issue.body:
## Context

Follow-up from #410 / PR #473. Mixed-mode take cards now show subtitles like `Take 1 - Pericope - vv. 8:31-9:1`, but on device the label is truncated because it shares the top row with the playback timer (`0:00 / 0:13`) in `DraftTakeRow` / `SharedTakeRow`.

Validated on Mark 8:31–9:1 pericope takes: the span text is correct, but users cannot read the full subtitle without hiding the timer locally.

## Problem

- `takeLabel` uses `numberOfLines={1}` beside a fixed-width timer in the top row.
- Cross-chapter pericope labels are longer than legacy `Take N` labels.

## Proposal

Improve take-card layout so full pericope subtitles are readable without losing timer access. Options to evaluate in design/impl:

1. Allow label to wrap (2 lines) and/or shrink timer typography
2. Move timer below the waveform (previewed locally — needs design sign-off)
3. Truncate with ellipsis only after 2 lines + expose full text via accessibility/long-press (last resort)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Full subtitle visible for cross-chapter pericope takes (e.g. `Take 1 - Pericope - vv. 8:31-9:1`) on a typical phone width without manual dev hacks
- [ ] Timer remains visible and usable for playback review
- [ ] Verse-only labels (`Take N - Verse - v. X`) still look correct
- [ ] `RecordTab` / take-row tests updated if layout changes

## Files likely involved

- `src/components/ui/DraftTakeRow.tsx`
- `src/components/ui/SharedTakeRow.tsx`
- `src/app/tabs/RecordTab.tsx` (if copy/placement changes)

## Related

- Parent: #410
- PR: #473
